ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 3:1 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are localized to the distal outer lobes. The left lobe features a large white region with dark linear intrusions extending from the leading edge. The right lobe exhibits more fragmented white mottling. The medial fluke body is a solid, low-intensity black contiguous mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide U-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-amplitude irregular serrations, transitioning into high-amplitude irregular protrusions at the distal tips caused by biological encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve sweeping upwards and outwards from the median notch toward the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white/beige pixel groups localized at both distal tips. Sparse white focal points are detected on the dark central surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned light-gray linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the dark pigmented surface of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization clusters at the lateral fluke tips; visible linear rake marks on the right ventral lobe surface.
